name: A pickaxe with a loose head
note: Doc 23. Mercantile, Act I. The head falls off twice for comedy and is always refittable, so this is a candidate for doc 22 section 6's object states rather than a second item.

LOOK_AT.say: A pickaxe. The head is loose, which is the only reason I could afford it.
repeat: Still loose. I have wedged it with a shim of pine and I am calling that repaired.
The head has come off twice. Both times it went forwards, which I choose to read as enthusiasm.

LISTEN_TO.say: The head, shifting on the haft. It has an opinion about being carried.
repeat: Nothing. It has settled, which worries me more.
